name: 🥣 Overnight Oats
tagline: Stir together at night, grab from the fridge at 7 am. Protein-packed and endlessly flavorable.

steps.text: In a big bowl stir the oats, milk, yogurt, honey, cinnamon, salt and chia.
Top each with berries (frozen ones thaw overnight and make a jammy layer).
Lid on and into the fridge overnight, at least 6 hours.
Morning: stir, add sliced banana and almonds, and go.

kid_jobs.job: Pick your own topping and label your jar

chef_tip: Add a pinch of salt. It's the difference between 'health food' and something that tastes like dessert.
make_ahead: Jars keep 4 days, so make Sunday night for Mon–Thu.
leftovers: Stir a spoon of peanut butter into day-3 jars to freshen them up.
